parent_gate: NR-M1O FORGE draft PR #1249, no accepted science

source.cohort: exact nine previously exposed MG56 DEV seeds per role, 18 episodes; no new world action

method.state: public image 7x7 3 components + literal public mission + heading
method.chronology: selected action and actual returned next public observation only; source event i cannot affect decision i; memory independent by actor role/family, retained chronologically across same family's three seeds

goal_relevance_signals.turn_only_change: selected left/right (0/1), heading or view changes; classify separately from objective effects
goal_relevance_signals.forward_view_change: selected forward (2) before/after public change; DO NOT assert true physical displacement
goal_relevance_signals.door_open: selected toggle(5), before public-front door type4 state1 or state2, after same-color public-front door type4 state0 with unchanged heading
goal_relevance_signals.door_close: selected toggle(5), before public-front door state0, after same-color type4 state1 and unchanged heading
goal_relevance_signals.mission_target_first_visible: public literal pickup mission exact type/color absent from before entire visible image, present after; observational exposure, not physical goal progress or learned semantics
goal_relevance_signals.mission_target_pickup_effect: selected pickup(3), before same-color/type exact mission target front, after front pixel floor type1, unchanged heading; does not claim hidden inventory
goal_relevance_signals.positive_terminal_goal: actual original reward >0 AND terminal true; not a proxy

method.native_guard: reproduce the original exact integer changed-action >=3; Laplace >=7500 and >= parent+1000 per same mission/direction/front pixel context, scan all seven hypothetical parent choices as optimistic eligibility only
method.association: at each eligible historical decision, count whether the alternative action's PRIOR same-context selected evidence includes any genuine public task-effect indicator; no causal counterfactual claim
metric_groups: per role/family and total changed selected actions by turn/forward/interaction
selected source door opening vs closing
public target visibility and actual exact target pickup
eligible vs no eligible source policy decision support, turn-only vs nonturn
prior observed task-relevant signal in eligible alternative action memory
method.stop_rule: if no prior task-relevant evidence in supported alternatives, declare current MG28 pure public-change signal unqualified for goal relevance; if positive, eligibility only and no original-world admission
controls: do not equate target sighting with reward
do not promote on retrospective associations
do not reuse DEV as heldout

admission: READ_ONLY ORIGINAL DEV, no source reset/step, no native model executable, no accepted-main/queue/FSA changes, no automatic scientific claim
